source.runtime: Android Kotlin Compose with React Native widget runtime
source.researchMethod: REA6.5.0 open_binary/extract_artifact, apktool decode_android_resources and installedCLI inspect_android_package/class/method; original byte identities and limitations preserved in selected receipts. Native runtime collection and Google Play gate recorded independently. A normal launch on the official Play-enabled emulator reached a documented Google Play licensing gate after sign-in; this environment-only A does not verify Hark core UI.

authentication.status: Google sign-in completed normally; Hark official Play listing is unavailable for the account country, and the unmodified signed sideload is rejected by the Google Play licensing gate before Hark login.
authentication.coverage: Only the launch environment outcome is observed. Hark authenticated core UI remains unverified. Account identifiers and credentials are excluded.

scope.goal: Extract Hark Android visual rules and native core component contracts for a future mobile controller; provide a reusable neutral reference without cloning Hark services or replacing the existing web study.
excludedBusiness: Subscription/billing, external connectors and account data
Android/iOS equivalence and unobserved state branches

supportedUses: 35个语义颜色角色的原生浅色/深色声明表。
13档原生自定义排版与局部发送控件几何，保留sp/dp。
可复用的独立输入、内容卡、选择sheet参考，明确D选择。
原生输入状态模型边界与后续手机控制器接入指南。
coreGaps: The current Google account cannot obtain Hark from Play in its country; the signed sideload is blocked before Hark login. Core native chat/cards/settings/keyboard and motion comparison require an eligible normally licensed device/account.
Native component geometry beyond focused send control, runtime font fallback and key transition measurements remain unverified.
Original font redistribution license unresolved; reference uses explicit system fallback.
optionalGaps: All business branches, billing/service integrations and background notification behavior are outside design scope.
Hermes widget payload internals and exact original spring coefficients are not required for the bounded reference.

reference.meaning: Native B-to-independent-D declaration mapping and reference smoke/pixel review; authenticated Android A comparison remains pending.

crossDomain.meaning: Five actual browser scenarios in a neutral field-research task slice; this conclusion concerns target transfer only.

omissions: OriginalAPK/XAPK/splits, decompiled source, proprietaryfonts/artwork remain local and uncommitted.
No accountprofile, credentials, signeddownload URLs, AVD/SDK/cache or privateusercontent is distributed.
Original webHark study is preserved without modification.
